ops.title: viz /api/graph is O(branches) serial git work — hangs 10+ min on big monorepos
ops.body:
Reproduced live on ~/Code/monorepo (23 local + 567 origin/* branches, 12GB packs, shallow): `GET /api/graph` returned 0 bytes after 600s while the server burned 6.5 min CPU; the SPA showed "Loading timeline…" forever (no client fetch timeout, no server deadline, no logging in internal/viz).

Root cause: `topology` (internal/viz/graph.go) does per-branch serial work for every enumerated branch — one `git merge-base` exec per branch (~1-2/s observed via child-process sampling), a go-git IsAncestor DAG walk per branch in detectMerge (go-git ignores the commit-graph real git uses; real `git merge-base` on the same repo takes 0.13s), an unmemoized re-walk of the trunk's first-parent merges per branch, and `FirstParentMerges(…, since=0)` (time-unbounded) per carrier in mineDeletedBranches. enumerate() has no cap or recency filter, and page reloads stack additional concurrent builds (graphMu deliberately not held across builds).

Not factors: shallow-clone handling (gitobj walks truncate gracefully at missing parents) and repo discovery (real git rev-parse; works from subdirs).

Diagnostic technique that cracked it: the first SIGQUIT goroutine dump showed NO stuck handler goroutine (it exits with the client's ctx on disconnect) — the tell was sampling mid-flight: 0% CPU + a serial stream of short-lived `git -C … merge-base <tip> <trunk>` children.

Fix shipped per plan ~/.claude/plans/ccn-viz-in-monorepo-pure-sparrow.md: batched for-each-ref enumeration + --merged detection, window-first lane filtering (trunk / in-window / merged-rescue / task-rescue), memoized+windowed walks, 8-way merge-base prefetch, MaxLanes cap + lanes_omitted, plus never-hang guardrails (singleflight builds, --build-timeout → 504, 90s client abort, 5xx + slow-build logging).
